{{Quote|Our universe is truly amazing. That book makes that even more apparent.|Extract from the guide's introduction|<ref name="WoSW" />}}
An '''annotated field guide''' was written by the famous [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] [[Lyrre T'enna]], with the contribution of the [[Intergalactic Zoological Society]], and published in a volume during the height of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It contained information on the physiology, [[Diet/Legends|diet]] and habitats of several wild [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures. The guide covered the wildlife of nine [[Planet/Legends|planets]] and [[Moon/Legends|moons]], namely [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="WoSW" />

Like the original field journals from which it was derived, the guide was richly illustrated in pen and ink, with annotations in the margins. All the [[Color/Legends|colored]] renderings of the book were drawn by T'enna herself on the fly, during on-site observation.<ref name="WoSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
T'enna's guide is the [[in-universe]] equivalent to the real-world book ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', which was written by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] and [[Bob Carrau]] and published by [[Chronicle Books]] in [[2001]].
